about: How the reader gives English for each kind of Greek it shows (milestone 15). Keys are 'view field' as tools/greek_audit.py names them; a key ending in * covers every field it begins.

kinds.beside: A printed English translation of the same words is shown beside it
kinds.workshop: The Workshop's own translation is shown beside it, labelled as such
kinds.passage: It quotes a passage: the English under it opens that passage in each translation, or the ancient text with its English beside it
kinds.named: An English name, label or explanation is printed with it
kinds.words: Greek words discussed inside English (a commentator's or a dictionary's): each word taps for its dictionary meaning
kinds.pending: Not translated yet: each word taps for its dictionary meaning meanwhile; a full translation is planned in ROADMAP.md

page chunks[].text.note: Burnet's Greek, with the translations of the same Stephanus page beside it in the reader

page tokens[].form.note: Burnet's words; each opens the word box

page chunks[].label.note: The speaker's abbreviation in Burnet (ΣΩ.), with the speaker's English name printed beside it

page commentary[]*.note: A commentary note on the page: the passage it is on is shown with its English on the same page

page links_in[]*.note: An excerpt of a note that cites the page

ancient/prolegomena-hermann sections[].t.note: The Workshop's translation of the whole Prolegomena (sources/translations/prolegomena-hermann.json)

ancient/albinus-hermann sections[].text.note: Burges' English (1854) of the same pages beside it (sources/translations/paired.json)

ancient/definitions-hermann sections[].t.note: Burges' English (1854) of the same definitions beside it (sources/translations/paired.json)

ancient/prolegomena-hermann title.note: The Greek title with its English

ancient/albinus-hermann title.note: The Greek title with its English

ancient/definitions-hermann title.note: The Greek title with its English

ancient/albinus-burges sections[].text.note: Greek words in the English translator's text and footnotes

ancient/alcinous-burges sections[].text.note: Greek words in the English translator's text and footnotes

ancient/definitions-burges sections[].te.note: Greek words in the English translator's text and footnotes

ancient/dl3-burges sections[].text.note: Greek words in the English translator's text and footnotes

ancient/dl3-yonge sections[].text.note: Greek words in the English translator's text and footnotes

commentary notes[].body_html.note: Greek inside an English commentary note: the commentator quotes or discusses the Greek

commentary notes[].anchor_detail.note: How the note was placed: the words it quotes

commentary notes[].lemma_text.note: The words of Plato the note is on: 'English' beside the place opens that section's translations

scholia*.note: The Greek scholia (Hermann, 1853): no English translation exists; a Workshop translation is planned (milestone 21 in ROADMAP.md)

taylor/general-introduction notes[].text.note: Taylor's footnote giving the Greek of a passage he translates in his text where the footnote mark stands

concepts concepts[].greek.note: The concept's Greek name beside its English name

concepts words[].lemma.note: Words whose renderings are compared: each opens every translator's English of it

concept greek.note: The concept's Greek name beside its English name

concept keywords*.note: Search words for the concept, not shown as text

concept compared[].note: Words whose renderings are compared: each opens every translator's English of it

concept definitions[].evidence[].quote.note: A definition in Hermann's Greek, with Burges' English of it beside it

concept later[].evidence[].quote.note: A later Platonist's Greek quoted with the English reading it supports

concept passages[].named[]*.note: An excerpt of a note that names the concept

concept terms[].lsj[].quote.note: LSJ's quotation of Plato, with LSJ's English sense above it and the passage's English under it

reading-order orders[]*.note: The Prolegomena's words on the order, with the Workshop's translation beside them

dossier greek.note: The passage's Greek name beside its English name

dossier keywords*.note: Search words, not shown as text

dossier editions[].chunks[].text.note: The Greek and the translations side by side, section by section

dossier renderings[]*.note: A key word or phrase, with each translator's English of it beside it

dossier diagram*.note: Plato's words under each part of a drawing, with the part's English label

dossier named[]*.note: An excerpt of a note that names the passage
